prompt: Vertical 9:16 close portrait of a groundskeeper in his late sixties, a made-up man nobody would recognise: a broad, round, ruddy face, a crooked nose that was broken once, bushy grey eyebrows, a short patchy grey beard, a flat cap pushed back on his head, small kind eyes creased from squinting outdoors.
